newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.11 down in the kerb market at 40.30 to the dollar on Sunday with dollars from the Gulf in short supply, dealers said.
One dealer said the rupee was likely to open lower on Monday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 9.00 percent, compared to the opening at 8.90 percent.
